subject: executor: fix the incorrect return when hash join encounters error (#59381)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/executor/join`. Change correctly propagates errors from `checkAndSpillRowTableIfNeeded` / `triggerIntest` in `buildWorkerBase.fetchBuildSideRows` via `errCh`, ensuring `buildFinished` carries the error so `wait4BuildSide` pushes it to `joinResultCh` (avoids `Next()` incorrectly returning `nil`/EOF on build-stage error). Adds `Issue59377` failpoint hook and a regression test (`TestIssue59377`) plus Bazel dep update. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/concurrency/runtime handling within executor scope.
